title: Rakim — Now streaming on Spotify
slide_intent: Let graphic shapes interrupt a photograph because controlled interruption can create rhythm while leaving the performer and message identifiable.
strategic_value: Spotify can turn a conventional concert photograph into recognizable campaign material through duotone color and circular cutouts.
demonstration: A wide red-purple Rakim photograph sits on black; black circles remove portions of the image while small copy and the logo anchor its lower edge.
practical_value: Assess where a graphic mask can overlap an image without hiding the essential gesture.

content_islands.name: Performer and masks
content_islands.spec: The microphone gesture remains visible between three differently sized black circular interruptions.
